newsitem.title: JAPAN: Prosecutors to arrest Nomura's Sakamaki -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors to arrest Nomura's Sakamaki -- paper.

text.p: The Tokyo Prosecutor's Office has decided to arrest Hideo Sakamaki, former president of Nomura Securities Co Ltd, for alleged violation of the Commercial Code, Mainichi Shimbun reported on Thursday.
The Japanese mass daily said Sakamaki is suspected of ordering former Nomura managing directors to provide 49 million yen of company money to a client linked to a "sokaiya" corporate racketeer.
In March, Sakamaki stepped down as president to atone for a scandal over the suspected illegal deals.
A spokesman for the prosecutor's office declined to comment on the report.
A Nomura spokeswoman also declined to comment.
